altText: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women on cushioned benches in a misty forest setting. A blonde woman behind a seated woman gently hugs her shoulders; the seated woman clasps hands with a woman leaning forward in a black-and-green leaf-pattern cropped romper. A fourth woman leans in from the right. Three outfits use blue, white and red flag stripes. Green knee-high boots, violet ankle boots, rainbow platforms and copper strappy heels vary across the group. Several outlined stars decorate the seated woman's upper arm.
